citation: NASA Earth Exchange Global Daily Downscaled Projections (NEX-GDDP-CMIP6), monthly COG ensemble-median product from the public two-model subset (GFDL-CM4 and GISS-E2-1-G), CC0. Source: https://registry.opendata.aws/nex-gddp-cmip6/ ; documentation: https://doi.org/10.7917/OFSG3345 . Accessed 2026-11-12. Monthly COG means for 2031-2035 minus 2010-2014; precipitation uses the future-to-historical monthly ratio; if the historical monthly mean is zero, the ratio is set to 1 because a multiplicative delta cannot represent a wet-month onset. Temperature deltas are K differences (numerically equal to °C differences).
